catch_rule: HSN/SAC printed on bill

catch_rule: GSTIN printed on bill vs vendor_master

catch_rule: reason not recorded

catch_rule: service entry does not exist on day one

pattern: PO not released yet
catch_rule: PO release status, not in extract
